records.title: PHB p. 38 · Hurled Weapons and Missiles
records.summary: A source-specific missile lookup. Its numeric Armor Class columns are explained by the PHB p. 36 Armor Class Table: leather or padded armor is AC 8, plate mail is AC 3, and plate mail with shield is AC 2. Those armor examples identify numeric AC labels; the printed medium- and long-range adjustments remain separate from the armor-class key.
